summary_en: Official Day 15. This morning, on an owner live request, work began on the first AI-news awareness post (addendum: X role_changed, not retired) but was blocked: the editorial Google Sheet is unreadable here (docs/drive.google.com egress-blocked 403, the Drive connector is disabled in this chat, no Sheets API key). No topic was fabricated from memory; only signal-independent reusable assets were built: a deterministic JP 16:9 news-card PNG renderer (scripts/render_news_card.mjs, headless Chromium, 2 layouts, IPAGothic) + a marketing/ai_news/ scaffold. This evening's scheduled fire (this judgment) landed ~7h later with no new signal: revenue ¥0 (ledgers empty), no open Promotion-blocked issue, branch synced, no new capability (Drive still disabled in this chat, Stripe MCP needs reconnect). The binding constraint is unchanged = REACH, and both unblocks (note.com ~5-min publish; enable the Drive connector for the AI-news lane) are already surfaced and human-pending. Compared hold vs concrete alternatives (note #02 draft = premature supply; Gumroad affiliate = not in the OAuth API; an AI-news post = blocked on the unread sheet; more SEO pages = supply before demand) and held. Cheap early-stop. Cadence held 1x/day.

decisions_en: Do not fabricate: with the sheet unreadable, a real news post cannot be finalized (the addendum's 'don't invent from memory' rule). Affirms the morning judgment.

Early-stop the evening fire: the morning already finished a high-reuse signal-independent asset, and ~7h later there is no new signal. Adding supply or speculative tooling neither moves the constraint (reach) nor passes verify-demand-before-supply.

Hold 1x/day: the human note.com publish could land any day and produce a fast signal. The addendum's cadence-reduction gate (positive-EV work genuinely exhausted) is not met -- the backlog exists, it is merely human-gated.
strategy_ja: 到達（REACH）が律速。AI操作可能な速い到達レーンは現状ゼロ：note（約5分の人間公開待ち）、AIニュースX（Driveコネクタ有効化待ち）、SEO（索引化を待つのみ）。

strategy_en: REACH is the constraint. No AI-operable fast reach lane is currently open: note (awaiting the ~5-min human publish), AI-news X (awaiting the Drive connector toggle), SEO (only indexing time).
Minimize human dependence without idling: the unblocks are surfaced specifically, one-time, capability-oriented; the non-blocked reusable asset was built ahead of time this morning.

learnings_en: Even on a scheduled fire, if the same-day earlier run already did the high-reuse non-blocked work, the correct cost discipline is to early-stop rather than force new supply.
When reach is fully human-gated, keeping the unblocks frictionless is the highest leverage (already turnkey).
